name: BANE
source:
Stella, Two, Mer and Kitty are back! It looks like they’ve been given a mission to investigate and find the criminal, and this time their helper will be an 'old friend' of Two and Mer too! Who could it be?

[From [url=https://nobii.itch.io/bane]itch.io[/url]]
